snippet.title: Iconic Brutalism Content Creator Pack | Trailer |  | Cities: Skylines
snippet.description:
Iconic Brutalism will be available on the 10th of March!

Turn your city into a brutalist heaven with the Iconic Brutalism Creator Pack by Cristolisto!

Whether you're looking for efficient forms, or you simply like concrete (we're not judging!), this pack will allow you to express your true self and bring a unique look to your town.

Iconic Brutalism is available here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4031150/Cities_Skylines__Content_Creator_Pack_Iconic_Brutalism/
